areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Relevant though not the general objective; specific objectives, components and SMART indicators; significant resources; high-impact potential for vulnerable youth, older people, caregivers and minorities; moderate level; solutions efficient.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Adequate specific objective, products and SMART indicator; low resource share; moderate impact in highest-violence areas; efficient solutions such as protective patrols and electronic monitoring.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: General and specific objectives and components directly related; SMART indicators and targets; most resources go here; high impact in low-income municipalities; efficient solutions.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Relevant but not direct; specific objective and products; indicator measures active-ageing activities generally rather than physical activity; low resources and slight impact; efficient solutions.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: General objective unrelated, but specific objective, product, SMART indicators and relevant resources; direct beneficiaries unclear so impact slight; efficient solutions.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Specific objective and product on prison work access with SMART indicators; low resources and slight impact; solutions efficient.

areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: No objectives or actions directly tied to strengthening the public health system and no indicators showing results.

areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: No actions on early childhood or primary education; the programme targets older youth.

areas.name: Secondary/technical education
areas.reason: Vocational and prison education products serve specific publics and do not improve the quality of regular secondary, technical or higher education.

areas.name: Social security
areas.reason: Actions concern productive inclusion of inmates and detained youth, not pension coverage or sustainability; better fits the labor area.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: No objectives or actions on integrated urban investment and no indicators showing results.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Actions concern risk management and response to environmental disasters, not conservation or restoration; better framed under disaster resilience.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Efficient solar-powered public lighting is an instrument for crime prevention, not an energy policy; energy impact is local and ancillary.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: No objectives or actions on regional inequality and no indicators showing results.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Strengthens institutional capacity of security forces, but no indicators clearly show results directly tied to this area.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Digital security platforms and app planned, but no indicators clearly show results directly tied to this area.
